items.title: Morgan Stanley Raises Palo Alto Networks Price Target to $410 on AI Security Demand
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) to $410 from $394, citing expectations that growing adoption of artificial intelligence will support cybersecurity spending and create opportunities for the company to expand its market share. The investment bank maintained its Overweight rating and identified Palo Alto Networks as its preferred stock within the sector.
